value.rationale: Exact all-time real W1/Lipschitz operator norm for all projective planes of every existing order, valid without incidence graph edge transitivity, with strict transient amplification, unique sharp peak, and nontrivial universal high-order 1.640464 limit. The direct transport matching and dual potential reveal how nonlocal heat kernels produce amplification unseen from adjacency spectra or curvature lower bounds alone. Natural cross-disciplinary benchmark for heat flow on incidence designs.
